content:
Update only `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml` by adding prod-only patches.

Example:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../clusters
  - ../../infra

patches:
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: app
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 4

  - target:
      kind: RDSInstance
      name: app-db
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/dbInstanceClass
        value: db.t3.medium
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/multiAz
        value: true

  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: app-assets
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/replicationConfiguration
        value:
          role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/s3-replication-role
          rules:
            - status: Enabled
              destination:
                bucket: arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-replica
                storageClass: STANDARD
              filter: {}
```

Notes:
- This keeps `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` untouched.
- Replace resource names if your actual base uses different names:
  - `app` → your Deployment name
  - `app-db` → your RDS resource name
  - `app-assets` → your S3 bucket resource name
- If your AWS CRDs use slightly different field names, keep the same prod-only patch approach and adjust paths accordingly.

If you want, I can also format this as a `git diff` against a typical existing `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`.
